author: Mental Outlaw
description:
In this video I show you how to use ntdevlabs tiny11builder to create a debloated windows 11 iso image.  Win11 ships with a lot of garbage (Copilot, ads, spyware and more) that are not necessary to run Windows 11 applications.  If you want a smaller windows 11 installation for running games or other windows 11 apps that don't run well under wine then I recommend using tiny11builder to create a minimalist windows image for running that software you need.

Try tiny11 yourself
https://github.com/ntdevlabs/tiny11builder
